data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Angelia is derived from the Greek word 'angelos', meaning messenger. In Christian tradition, the name Angelia is given to those believed to be messengers of God. The name Angelia carries the meaning “Messenger of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Parents who choose Angelia usually hope their child will grow to embody messenger of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
